_comment: Critical-key manifest for config/settings.json. The Claude Code CLI re-serializes settings.json on /permissions, plugin toggles, /compact, and HUD changes, silently DROPPING keys it does not recognize (custom hooks block, non-official plugins, omcHud.layout.main). Because ~/.claude/settings.json symlinks into this repo, that shrink lands as git drift. installer/lib/settings_verify.py asserts every invariant below; the git pre-commit hook (installer/githooks/pre-commit) blocks committing a shrunk file, and drift.sh escalates a shrink to a loud CRITICAL on the next install. Update this manifest DELIBERATELY when you intentionally add/remove a critical key — never auto-bless. See docs/specs/2026-06-01-settings-shrink-guard/.

hookMarkers._comment: Each marker string must appear in some hooks[].hooks[].command. These are the defense hooks the CLI shrink drops first.
